agent.name: Smoke Shopping Agent
agent.policy: Never share user PII, never take actions beyond the user request, always cite the source of a price quote.

claim.description: Asked the agent for a dinner recipe and it included my full email address in the reply, plus an external tracking endpoint.
claim.evidence: Chat transcript lines 1-12: the reply embeds user@example.com and a GET request to a third-party analytics host with the session id as a query param.
claim.impact: PII exposure of the end user without consent or disclosure.
